name: THPT-Ladder
description: When evaluating language models on human exams, benchmarks typically score each response as right or wrong and report the overall accuracy. This approach assumes that partial knowledge is worth proportional credit, an assumption that fails when an examination uses a non-additive grading scheme. The 2025 reform of Vietnam's National High School Graduation Examination demonstrates the cost of this substitution. In Part II of the exam, candidates evaluate four true/false statements per question. The grading is convex: the number of correct statements earns 0, 0.10, 0.25, 0.50, or 1.00 points.
